title: How Far Have We Gone in VULNERABILITY DETECTION USING LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing confusion matrices from model evaluations on vulnerability datasets (CTF, MAGMA, Big-Vul) to identify statistical propensities toward outputting specific vulnerability types (e.g., 'Buffer Overflow') or exhibiting excessive conservatism (predicting 'No Vulnerability') due to RLHF or SFT alignment.
